title: Caching with Redis — Companion
description: Runnable Redis caching examples in three stacks: the cache-aside decorator (redis-py), lease-lock and early-refresh stampede defenses, an ioredis getCached helper with INCR/EXPIRE rate limiting, and a Jedis pool client.
description_es: Ejemplos ejecutables de caching con Redis en tres stacks: el decorador cache-aside (redis-py), defensas contra stampede con lease lock y refresco temprano, un helper getCached en ioredis con rate limiting INCR/EXPIRE, y un cliente Jedis con pool.
